text: The purpose of this report is to make changes to the Fairbank Village Business Improvement Area Board of Management, in accordance with the requirements of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 19, Business Improvement Areas. The Fairbank Village Business Improvement Area falls within two Community Council boundaries.

City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appoint the following nominee to the Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below at pleasure of Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as a successor is appointed: Fairbank Village: Kurt Konietzny 2. City Council remove the following director from the Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below: Fairbank Village: Luisa Maria Cancelli
